damageProperties.name: Disruptive Force weakness
damageProperties.note: Disables 1 ethereal ability for a round.

damageProperties.name: Piercing Boon
damageProperties.note: +1 damage on this creature's melee attacks per instance of piercing damage currently stuck in it (arrows, etc.) - track by hand.

damageProperties.name: Blighted Connection
damageProperties.note: After taking necrotic damage, any radiant damage dealt by this creature is halved until the end of its next turn.

damageProperties.name: Flammable Flesh
damageProperties.note: Once per turn, taking fire damage sets this creature ablaze, causing them to take an extra 5 fire damage.

damageProperties.name: Explosive Fluids
damageProperties.note: When a demon is reduced to 0 hit points from an effect that deals fire damage, they explode, dealing Xd6 fire damage in a 10-foot radius around them, with X being equal to half of the creature's CR (minimum of 1d6).

damageProperties.name: Zuggtmoy's Rancor
damageProperties.note: While the Devil is poisoned, it is unable to take the dash, disengage, or dodge actions, and if they have a flying speed, it is halved. Taking poison damage also causes the Devil to suffer these effects, except they only last until the end of their next turn.

damageProperties.name: Conductive Scales
damageProperties.note: The dragon has disadvantage on saving throws against bolts of lightning or spell effects that deal lightning damage.

damageProperties.name: Superconductor
damageProperties.note: Whenever this dragon would take lightning damage, it instead takes no damage and immediately regains its breath weapon. Alternative to a plain Lightning immunity entry for Blue/Bronze dragons.

monsters.name: Ghost
monsters.languages: any languages it knew in life

damageProfile.note: Replaces the old Acid/Fire/Lightning/Thunder/nonmagical-attack resistances from the stock 5e ghost.
Disables 1 ethereal ability for a round.

monsters.conditionImmunities: Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Prone, Restrained

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.text: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Etherealness
traits.text: The ghost can enter the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, and vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while on the Ethereal Plane, and vice versa, but can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Withering Touch
actions.text: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (4d6+3) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.text: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 hit point instead.

actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6+1) bludgeoning damage.
